title: Xuanwu Presses the Border
next_chapter_hook: Just as the entire Tianqing Sect stood on high alert, an encrypted secret report quietly landed in Chen Ji's hands—the Xuanwu Sect's true target this time was not the Tianqing Sect at all, but the Grand Tutor's Residence in the imperial capital a thousand miles away.

text.content:
Outside the Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate.

The massive Xuanwu Sect army pressed down like dark clouds, three thousand iron-clad soldiers arrayed outside the sect's protective formation. As spiritual energy surged, even the sky above was tinged with a grim grayish-white. War drums boomed, each beat striking at the hearts of every Tianqing Sect disciple present.

"Han Lie of the Xuanwu Sect leads the great army here, specially to pay respects to all fellow cultivators of the Tianqing Sect!"

The roar rolled forth, carrying an unbridled arrogance, as if the Tianqing Sect was already a lamb waiting to be slaughtered.

dialogue.content: (Han Lie stands atop the iron war chariot,玄武虚影 surrounding his form, his voice like a great bell) Today, thirty thousand disciples and eighteen elders of my Xuanwu Sect have come not to annihilate your sect, but merely to ask the Tianqing Sect to hand over one person—that waste Chen Ji, I hear he's at your sect?

text.content:
Inside the Servant Disciple quarters, Chen Ji sits cross-legged, his fingertips gently manipulating an ancient Turtle Shell.

On the shell, forty-nine runes flicker faintly—those are the forty-nine pieces he has placed across the world. And right now, one of them is vibrating at a peculiar frequency.

Not an ordinary warning.

But rather... the mark of being manipulated by a higher existence.

dialogue.content: (Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul emerges from the first page of the Tianji Record, his voice drifting) The forty-ninth piece... someone has touched it. Boy, do you sense it?

text.content:
Chen Ji does not answer.

He closes his eyes, the aura of the Tianji Record flickering at his brow center. A blurry image flashes through his mind—a massive eyeball woven from countless golden threads, piercing through the Void to gaze upon every piece on the chessboard.

"The Eye of Heavenly Way..."

Chen Ji's eyes snap open, pupils slightly contracting. This is the first time he has truly sensed traces of this terrifying existence, rather than merely reading warnings on the Tianji Record Fragment.

Meanwhile, inside the Tianqing Sect Council Hall, three elders sit with grim expressions.

"The formation can hold at most three days." The Grand Elder's voice was heavy, exhaustion evident. "The Xuanwu Sect came prepared this time, even summoning the sect's hidden Iron War Formation. We cannot withstand them by force."

"Then let's negotiate peace!" The Second Elder abruptly rose. "It's just handing over a servant disciple. Chen Ji, that waste—"

"Silence." The Grand Elder coldly cut him off. "You humiliated him so severely that day, and now you'd hand him over as a gift? What would the world think of our Tianqing Sect?"

dialogue.content: (The old Sect Master Ling Yuan slowly speaks, his voice calm yet carrying undeniable authority) No need to argue. Since Chen Ji is a disciple of our sect, he is a person of the Tianqing Sect. But... if he could resolve this situation himself, wouldn't that be better?

choice.prompt: The Xuanwu Sect army presses against the mountain gate, the sect faces imminent crisis. You sense the gaze of the Eye of Heavenly Way strengthening, and you've learned the Xuanwu Sect's true target may be something else entirely. How will you respond?

choices.text: Take the initiative to strike, using your identity as Crown Prince's Grand Tutor to intimidate
choices.description: Reveal the Crown Prince Grand Tutor identity bestowed by the imperial court, suppress the Xuanwu Sect's arrogance with royal law, letting Han Lie know exactly who he's provoking.
choices.visible_cost: Reveal a portion of your strength
choices.visible_reward: Han Lie gets humiliated publicly, Tianqing Sect morale soars
choices.risk_hint: May attract more attention, complicating the situation further

text.content:
Chen Ji steps out of the servant quarters, his form flickering, already appearing atop the mountain gate. Hands clasped behind his back, his cold gaze sweeps across the dark army below, the corners of his mouth slightly raised.

"Han Lie, what an impressive display from your Xuanwu Sect." His voice is not loud, yet it clearly reaches everyone's ears. "I wonder, if the Crown Prince were to learn of this, would he be displeased?"

choices.text: Hold position and continue arranging pieces while observing secretly
choices.description: Let the three elders handle it first. You remain hidden in the shadows, observing the situation and waiting for the optimal moment to act. Also investigate the anomaly of the Eye of Heavenly Way.
choices.visible_reward: Maintain an air of mystery, gain more intelligence

text.content:
Chen Ji withdraws his gaze and closes his eyes once more. The Tianji Record Fragment slowly turns in his mind, the vibration of the forty-ninth piece growing increasingly intense.

"Interesting..." he murmurs. "Han Lie is merely the piece in the light. The real chess player... is someone else."

choices.text: Activate the Tianji Record to peer three hours into the future
choices.description: Consume 5 points of Heavenly Fate, use the Tianji Record to foresee the critical developments in the next three hours, finding the key to breaking the deadlock.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain crucial intelligence, learn the Xuanwu Sect's true purpose
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate consumption will accelerate fate's fatal backlash

text.content:
Chen Ji bites his fingertip, a drop of blood falling onto the Tianji Record Fragment. Golden light suddenly flares, his consciousness pulled into a chaotic mist.

Images blur and flash—Xuanwu Sect banners, the imperial capital's walls, a figure shrouded in black mist... and a pair of golden eyes watching him.

"Do you see, chess piece?" An aged yet majestic voice echoes in his mind. "You think you're arranging the board, but you too are within the game."

dialogue.content: (Su Qingyao quietly appears behind Chen Ji, her voice barely above a whisper) Chen Ji, the Xuanwu Sect comes with overwhelming force, the three elders can't hold the situation. What's... your actual plan?

text.content:
Chen Ji turns, seeing the anxiety in this Inner Disciple Senior Fellow's eyes, his heart slightly stirred.

This woman... has approached the truth for the third time.

"What plans could a waste servant disciple possibly have, Senior Sister Su?" He smiles, his tone carrying a hint of playfulness. "I'm just here to watch the show."

Su Qingyao's brow furrows tightly: "Do you take me for blind? Han Lie named you specifically—would the Xuanwu Sect mobilize their entire force for a waste?"

choice.prompt: Su Qingyao presses closer, this being her third time almost discovering the truth. How will you respond?

choices.text: Half-truth, reveal part of the truth
choices.description: Tell her Han Lie has another mastermind behind him, and that you're arranging a response. Show appropriate weakness to gain her trust and assistance.
choices.visible_reward: Su Qingyao's favor increases, may become an ally
choices.risk_hint: She may act impulsively, disrupting your plans

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji drops his smile, lowering his voice) Senior Sister Su, some things are dangerous for you to know. But I can tell you this... Han Lie is merely a puppet on stage. The real chess player hides somewhere deeper.

choices.text: Continue playing dumb, letting her keep guessing
choices.description: Use the same trick again, dispelling her doubts with the waste persona. You've deflected her three times already, what's one more?
choices.visible_cost: Miss the opportunity to recruit her
choices.visible_reward: Continue maintaining mystery, Su Qingyao will become even more curious
choices.risk_hint: She may already be suspicious, won't be easily fooled

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji spreads his hands innocently) What plans could I possibly have? I haven't even broken through Foundation Building. You can't expect this waste to challenge Han Lie solo, right? Senior Sister Su overestimates me.

text.content:
Before he finishes speaking, a sharp whooshing sound interrupts their conversation.

A spirit dove swoops down, landing on Chen Ji's shoulder. He removes the thin bamboo tube tied to the dove's leg, unrolling the note inside. His expression slightly shifts.

"What's wrong?" Su Qingyao moves closer.

Chen Ji tucks the note into his sleeve, his gaze profound: "Urgent report from the capital. Something's happened at the border."

But what he doesn't say—the note contains a line only he can read: "Xuanwu's target is not the mountain gate, the Grand Tutor's Residence is the real prize."

Han Lie's voice rings out from outside the mountain gate once more, this time with naked threats: "Tianqing Sect members, I'll ask one last time—will you hand over Chen Ji or not?"

"If you won't cooperate, that's fine too." A cruel smile curves his lips. "Then we'll annihilate the Tianqing Sect first and search for him slowly. Let's see how long this waste can hide!"

The Xuanwu Sect army roars in unison, spiritual energy fluctuations intensify, all-out war is imminent.

choice.prompt: The Xuanwu Sect is about to launch a full-scale attack, the Tianqing Sect's survival hangs by a thread. You now know their true target is the Grand Tutor's Residence. What will you choose?

choices.text: Intervene and protect the Tianqing Sect
choices.description: Reveal a portion of your strength, personally repulse the Xuanwu Sect vanguard, letting everyone in the Tianqing Sect witness your methods.
choices.visible_cost: Expose your strength, drawing greater attention
choices.visible_reward: The entire Tianqing Sect will look at you with new eyes, Su Qingyao completely turns in your favor
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan may seize the opportunity to make a move

text.content:
Chen Ji walks forward slowly, his form ghostlike as he glides to the mountain gate. One hand behind his back, the other waves gently—

BOOM!

A terrifying sword qi materializes from nothing, forcibly pushing the Xuanwu Sect vanguard back a hundred zhang. Han Lie's pupils contract sharply, his face filled with disbelief: "This... how is this possible!"

"Waste?" Chen Ji says calmly. "Your Xuanwu Sect vanguard couldn't even block one strike from this waste?"

choices.text: Secretly transmit a voice message, making Ling Yuan take the blame
choices.description: You already know the Xuanwu Sect's true target. The Grand Tutor's Residence has old grudges with Ling Yuan—seize this opportunity to push Ling Yuan forward as a shield.
choices.visible_reward: Ling Yuan is forced to step forward, the Xuanwu Sect's spear points elsewhere
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan may sense your scheme

text.content:
The corners of Chen Ji's mouth lift slightly, his fingers gently flick within his sleeve. An invisible transmission talisman pierces through the void, quietly entering Ling Yuan's ear.

"Old Sect Master, the Xuanwu Sect's true target isn't the Tianqing Sect at all, but the Grand Tutor's Residence in the capital. Your old grudge with the Grand Tutor's Residence... they've investigated it thoroughly."

Ling Yuan's expression shifts dramatically, his gaze toward the Xuanwu Sect army gaining a more somber edge.

choices.text: Use a clever escape, rush to the Grand Tutor's Residence
choices.description: The Tianqing Sect is merely a smokescreen. You must race back to the Grand Tutor's Residence first, laying a trap in the enemy's path before they make their move.
choices.visible_cost: The Tianqing Sect may suffer losses
choices.visible_reward: Protect the Grand Tutor's Residence's foundation, turn the tables in the enemy's lair
choices.risk_hint: May be branded as a deserter

text.content:
Chen Ji's gaze deepens as he rapidly calculates in his heart.

"Senior Sister Su, please relay this to the three elders—hold firm for three days, and there will surely be a turning point." The words fall, and his form already dissolves into an afterimage, vanishing into the night.

Su Qingyao stands frozen, staring at the direction where he disappeared, murmuring: "Just how many trump cards... do you still have hidden?"

The moment Chen Ji departs, the forty-ninth rune on the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly blazes with light.

That ethereal voice rings in his Mental Sea once more—

"Interesting little chess piece... did you think you could escape?"

"On heaven's chessboard, there are no true bystanders."

Chen Ji whirls around sharply, only to catch a fleeting glimpse of golden light vanishing into the Void. Those invisible eyes are watching him from even higher ground, observing every move he makes.

And in the end, he is but a single chess piece.

dialogue.content:
(The will of the Eye of Heavenly Way thunders like great bells and massive drums, shaking Chen Ji's soul) You peeked three hours into the future, so what? I have been arranging pieces for ten thousand years—how could an ant like you possibly shake it?

Go, go see your Grand Tutor's Residence... see what you can actually protect.

text.content:
Chen Ji takes a deep breath, suppressing the unease in his heart.

So what if there's an Eye of Heavenly Way? So what if it's been scheming for ten thousand years?

This Chen Ji has never believed in fate.

"I remember." He murmurs to himself, his voice carrying a hint of resolve. "When I've consumed your pieces one by one, this so-called chess player... will also be nothing but a lamb for slaughter."

His form flickers and vanishes into the night sky, racing toward the imperial capital a thousand miles away.

Behind him, the Tianqing Sect mountain gate stands silent under the moonlight.

A greater storm is brewing.
